title: Digital Nitrogen Tyre Inflator Four Hose System - NITROJET 6000 LCV 4H
description: Digital nitrogen tyre inflator with four hose system for simultaneous operation.
subtitle: Four Hose System
fullDescription: Digital nitrogen tyre inflator with four hose system for simultaneous operation. Features two digital readouts, big LCD display, reliable PSA method for nitrogen generation, air and nitrogen input pressure option available in single machine, inbuilt pressure booster for nitrogen storage, and can be used for vehicle tyre ranging from SUV, mini truck, bus and truck up to 180 PSI.
features: Two digital readouts one for set pressure and other for tyre pressure
LCD display with back light to provide good visibility
Display remain at same set pressure value even at power on-off cycle
Audible and visual end of the cycle signal indicators
LED indication for the status of operation
Soft touch and durable membrane keys suitable for outdoor
Separate keys for set pressure increment and decrement
Flat key for empty or puncture tyre
VAC key (VACUUM KEY) for first time nitrogen filling
Computer power chord adapter with fuse protection and switch on indicator
Pressure switch for automatic nitrogen generation cut-off
Pressure gauge for input air pressure indication and internal tank nitrogen pressure indication
Safety pressure relief valve available for internal tank
Reliable PSA method for nitrogen generation
Air and nitrogen input pressure option available in single machine
Four hose system for simultaneous operation
Inbuilt pressure booster for nitrogen storage
Can use for vehicle tyre ranging from SUV, mini truck, bus and truck up to 180 PSI
